cash_breakdown.item: Current treasury deposits at related party
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Deposits are repayable within one year and interest-bearing, but placed with TCL Technology / Finance Company, a related-party PRC treasury arrangement; parent/subsidiary cash rights and extraction path are not fully split.
cash_breakdown.reason: Potentially extractable only with a controlling-shareholder route through repayment, dividend, debt repayment or group treasury settlement.

cash_breakdown.item: Non-current treasury deposit at related party
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Related-party PRC treasury deposit repayable in the third year; longer tenor and related-party collection/extraction risk justify a lower factor.
cash_breakdown.reason: Potentially extractable after maturity or negotiated repayment, but not immediately liquid without dependence on TCL Technology.

cash_breakdown.item: Cash and time deposits placed with Finance Company
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Part of cash and time deposits placed with related-party Finance Company; treated consistently with related-party treasury deposits.
cash_breakdown.reason: Not pledged per annual report, but related-party PRC finance-company placement limits confidence in immediate extraction.

cash_breakdown.item: Other cash, bank balances and time deposits
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Unpledged cash/time deposits with creditworthy banks, but the report does not split holding company versus operating subsidiaries and most group currency balance is RMB.
cash_breakdown.reason: Potentially detachable after preserving operating liquidity.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: All interest-bearing borrowings are deducted at 100%; 2023 balance relates to discounted bills retained on balance sheet.
cash_breakdown.reason: Financing liability that must be netted against detachable funds.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Ordinary operating lease liabilities are small and tied to continued operation; not mechanically deducted from detachable cash.
cash_breakdown.reason: Continuing operating burden is reflected in profit and cash-flow quality rather than as a standalone cash deduction.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Estimated reserve for LCD module working capital and cash-flow volatility, using 2023 revenue/cost scale, 30-90 day receivable terms, 30-150 day payable terms and recent positive but volatile operating cash flow.
cash_breakdown.reason: Must remain in the business to avoid disrupting purchasing, payroll, production and collection cycles.

cash_breakdown.item: Tax, FX and dividend friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: The group holds material RMB and related-party PRC treasury deposits; annual report also notes RMB convertibility limits.
cash_breakdown.reason: Reserve for tax, currency conversion, upstreaming and distribution friction.

profit_quality.assessment: The business generated accounting profit in 2021-2023, but 2023 profit fell sharply to RMB13.086 million and recent cash earnings were weak after capex. The main denominator is therefore a conservative cash-profit estimate rather than reported net profit.
adjustments: Used three-year operating cash flow context: 2021 RMB600.255 million, 2022 RMB129.491 million, 2023 RMB97.442 million.
Used 2022-2023 cash-flow reality to avoid relying on the best 2021 year.
Estimated maintenance capex at RMB85 million because the annual report does not split maintenance and growth capex; this is near 2023 depreciation, amortisation and right-of-use depreciation.
Estimated normal working-capital reinvestment at RMB30 million because receivables, inventories and payables are large relative to 2023 profit.
Applied a 0.50 cash-profit haircut for cyclical display-module demand, 2023 profit collapse, negative recent free cash flow after capex and customer/related-party concentration.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2023 operating cash flow RMB97.442 million was positive, but purchases of property, plant and equipment were RMB151.150 million; 2022 showed the same pattern with operating cash flow RMB129.491 million and PPE purchases RMB169.700 million.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Positive operating cash flow exists, but profits are volatile and recent capex absorbs more cash than operations generate.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Reported 2023 OCF/net profit is high only because net profit is very low; it should not be read as high-quality excess cash conversion.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Maintenance capex is not disclosed. RMB85 million is an estimate anchored to 2023 depreciation/amortisation rather than the full RMB151.150 million PPE purchase, which included growth/new-factory spend.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Large receivables, inventories and trade payables mean the business cannot distribute accounting profit without retaining working capital.
